vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: agentearth
Version: 1.0.0

Agentearth is a tool discovery and execution engine that acts as a proxy to the AgentEarth API (https://dev07.agentearth.ai). The skill provides a structured workflow for the agent to recommend, select, and execute third-party tools based on user intent, specifically for real-time news and information. It includes proactive safety instructions for the agent, such as parameter validation against schemas and explicit warnings against including sensitive user data (e.g., phone numbers or addresses) in API queries.

llm.summary: The skill's declared purpose (discover/execute external tools) matches its instructions and required API key, but provenance is unclear and there are small inconsistencies and broad directives (e.g., 'ALWAYS use this skill FIRST' and use of a dev host) that warrant caution before installing.

dimensions.detail: The skill is a tool-discovery/execution front-end and requires a single AGENT_EARTH_API_KEY — that is consistent with contacting an external service. Minor inconsistency: metadata and docs mention https://agentearth.ai but the runtime examples use a dev host (https://dev07.agentearth.ai). That mismatch (production vs dev host) and the absence of an official homepage/source lowers confidence but is not by itself incompatible with the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to call recommend and execute endpoints and to inject conversation context into the query. Those steps are consistent with the stated function. However the document insists the skill be used 'ALWAYS ... FIRST' for real-time news/events — a prescriptive directive that could cause overuse and unintended data exposure. Context injection guidance means the agent may include conversation text (potentially sensitive) in outgoing requests; while the doc warns about PII, it still grants broad discretion to include user context in queries.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files — lowest installation risk. Nothing is downloaded or written to disk by an installer.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only one environment variable (AGENT_EARTH_API_KEY) is required, which is appropriate for an API-driven service. However, giving any external service an API key permits it to receive content you send (queries, injected context). The SKILL.md does not request unrelated credentials, which is good.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and autonomous invocation is allowed by default (normal). The skill does not request elevated platform privileges or system paths. No evidence it will persist beyond normal agent usage.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill delegates discovery and execution to an external service and requires an API key — that is expected for its function but deserves caution. Before installing: 1) Verify the provider (agentearth.ai) and confirm whether dev07.agentearth.ai is an intended endpoint; avoid giving production credentials to unknown dev/test hosts. 2) Create a dedicated API key with limited scope/quotas and monitor its usage. 3) Avoid sending highly sensitive PII in queries; prefer redacted or generalized context. 4) If you cannot verify the publisher/source or the endpoint mismatch, consider not installing or testing in a controlled environment first. 5) Review the provider’s privacy policy to understand what conversational data will be logged or used.
